The '''Jostaar system''' was located in the [[Kibilini sector/Legends|Kibilini sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Jostaar Express]]''.<ref name="Tethan">''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Jostaar [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed it in grid square Q-17.<ref name="EAOC" />
